results.instruction: Remove the bottom cover of the mouse by unscrewing the screws.
Take out the internal components from the mouse casing.
Inspect the internal components of the mouse.
Check the circuit board and other parts inside the mouse.
Examine the wiring and connections within the mouse.
Look closely at the sensor and other small components.
Reassemble the mouse by placing the internal components back into the casing.
Align the top and bottom covers of the mouse.
Secure the mouse casing by screwing the screws back in place.
Ensure all screws are tightly fastened.
Test the mouse to ensure it functions correctly.
Connect the mouse to a computer via the USB cable.
Verify that the mouse cursor moves smoothly on the screen.
Check the responsiveness of the mouse buttons.
Confirm the scroll wheel operates properly.
Finalize the setup by disconnecting the mouse from the computer.
